bbmp_ned (I1223c, old row I710o): ned_engine.cpp and engine.h from github.com/creep-ltx/bbmp csrc/retro, commit
19d87098b3716156d80224d22dc49ca22884d1b7 (GPL-3.0-or-later, SPDX line in each file, COPYING). NerdTracker II songs (.ned, NES): the engine
puts the tracker's replay routine, the song and the DPCM samples into an NSF image in memory and has Game Music Emu (selecta_gme) play it.

ned_engine.cpp differs from upstream in one place: share_dir() (executable-relative share/ lookup through self_path.h) returns g_replay_dir,
which bned_glue.cpp sets from the paths the host resolved for the two declared system files. Nothing else changed. engine.h is unchanged.

The replay routine is NOT vendored, NOT in the repo, NOT in the pack (Johan 2026-11-06). It is Bananmos' "replay 22" (nt2-22.asm, ca65 port by
Memblers), giftware: "free for any non-commercial usage" (NERDTRACKER2-TERMS.txt). Two I710ga system files, fetched from the hippoplayer.se
mirror (sysfiles/nt2replay.bin, sysfiles/nt2replay.lbl) or built by the user. Build recipe = bbmp tools/build-retro.sh, ned part:
  nedplay.zip https://www.nesdev.org/nt2/download/nedplay.zip sha256 84602a2164280c3a10b080c21fd43f3cac7b6e41e6a53e94faf859c596b4e76f
  unzip nt2-22.asm DPCMCODE.INC; empty TEMP.DTT and temp.dmc; songs.asm = "ned1..ned17 = $FFFF"; the linker config blob.cfg of build-retro.sh;
  ca65 -g nt2-22.asm -o nt2-22.o && ld65 -C blob.cfg -Ln nt2replay.lbl -o nt2replay.bin nt2-22.o   (cc65 2.19)
  nt2replay.bin 3038 bytes sha256 8ac3e74346e8374bf9ad522bdae0a21cf1f248c254b563acf4ea363b63be0d21
  nt2replay.lbl 3404 bytes sha256 daca7169d17c5390a01eeff155011dc68c6fa49692f5904b4b86f5c250b83fe7
